name: Fodders Grapple Gauntlet
summary:
Fodders Grapple Gauntlet is a first-person parkour and grappling game focused on speed, precision, and movement mastery. Your goal is simple: reach the end of each level as fast as possible.

Using a responsive grapple hook as your primary movement tool, you’ll swing, launch, and chain momentum to navigate challenging obstacle courses. Levels are designed to reward skill, experimentation, and efficient routes.

The game features a retro-inspired visual style, with a dark background and brightly colored blocks that are easy to read at high speeds. Each block type behaves differently, requiring you to adapt your movement and plan your path carefully to achieve faster times.
